title: PartGap part entry v0.1
description: One entry per part model (e.g. Feetech STS3215 7.4V). Holds identified actuator parameters, where they were measured, how large the remaining simulation error is, and how far the entry can be trusted outside the measured conditions.

variant.description: voltage / gear-ratio variant if the product name covers several

control.description: how the firmware turns a goal position into motor drive

firmware.description: firmware constants of the position loop: error_gain (duty per rad per kp unit), max_pwm, default_max_velocity (goal rate limit, rad/s, null if none)

sources.description: Every dataset that went into this entry. One source = one physical unit on one test bench.

unit.description: unit id inside the source (physical motor)

conditions.description: Range of conditions the logs cover. A query outside these ranges is an extrapolation and is flagged.

load_inertia.description: kg m^2 at the output shaft

identifications.description: Identified parameters per friction model. m1 = Coulomb + viscous (native in MuJoCo/PyBullet). m6 = BAM extended model (needs the BAM plugin).

error.description: Held-out open-loop position error (mean absolute, degrees) on the random 80/20 split, per model. b0 = no identification (start values, no friction).

by_condition.description: m1/m6 error of the all-logs fit, broken down by kp, load group and trajectory

transfer.description: How much the error grows when the entry is used outside what it was fit on. ratio = held-out-condition error / error of a fit that saw that condition, on the same logs.

backdrive.description: error in torque-off (back-driven fall) phases of lift_and_drop logs: fit that never saw lift_and_drop (heldout_off_deg) vs fit that did (seen_off_deg)

other_unit.description: only when a second unit of the same model exists
